name: Dolatabad

queries.query: Dolatabad Iran official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry
queries.result: Search identified Iran's Registration Organization of Deeds and Properties (SSAA) cadastral ecosystem and an Isfahan provincial registration-office listing that includes the Borjwar/Dolatabad registration office. No first-party public Dolatabad parcel viewer, vector endpoint, or safe anonymous parcel response was found.

queries.query: دولت آباد اصفهان نقشه کاداستر رسمی املاک ثبت اسناد نقشه GIS
queries.result: نتایج به سازمان ثبت اسناد و املاک کشور و سامانه‌های کاداستر و شمیم اشاره کردند. نتیجه‌ای از فهرست ثبت اسناد استان اصفهان اداره ثبت اسناد و املاک برخوار (دولت آباد) را ذکر می‌کند، اما لایه عمومی ناشناس با شناسه امن و هندسه قطعه برای دولت آباد پیدا نشد.

registryEvidence.candidateCustodian: Registration Organization of Deeds and Properties of Iran (SSAA), including its cadastral and Shamim systems; Isfahan provincial registration administration is the locality-relevant office reference.
registryEvidence.locality: Dolatabad, Isfahan Province; search result references اداره ثبت اسناد و املاک برخوار (دولت آباد).
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The provincial/local-office result is a directory listing, not a first-party cadastral map, procedure, or parcel API. National SSAA service existence does not establish public anonymous Dolatabad coverage. Therefore registryFound remains null.

parcelDiscovery.note: No parcel polygon was retained. The supplied exact WUP point was used unchanged only as the research coordinate; it was not shifted and a point miss or unavailable service was not treated as citywide absence.

uncertainty: Ordinary HTTPS GET attempts to https://ssaa.ir, https://cadastre.ssaa.ir, https://shamim.ssaa.ir, and https://my.ssaa.ir timed out before a usable HTML or JavaScript/configuration response; no login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, or TLS bypass was used.
Ordinary HTTPS GET to the listed Isfahan registry host https://sabt-es.ir failed DNS resolution, and https://dolatabad.ir failed DNS resolution; these failures do not establish service absence.
No official viewer configuration, schema/CRS declaration, bounded anonymous ID+geometry response, WMS feature response, or safe parcel endpoint was obtained.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account, personal, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
